name: application-now-playing-bar
title: Now Playing Bar
description: Full-width bottom-docked music player bar with album art, title/artist, a live scrubber, and prev/play/next transport controls — distinct from audio-player, which is a card-style waveform podcast player rather than an app-shell-docked bar.
useWhen: A persistent playback bar should dock to the bottom of the app shell across pages.
You need standard prev/play-pause/next transport controls alongside a linear scrubber.
Album art and track metadata should stay visible while the user navigates elsewhere.
avoidWhen: You want a self-contained card player with a waveform visualization — use audio-player instead.
You need a queue of upcoming tracks — pair this with a separate queue list component.
There is no persistent playback state to dock — an inline audio-player card is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The bar spans the full container width; title/artist truncate with ellipsis and the time readout and transport controls stay fixed at narrow widths.
accessibility: The scrubber's fill carries role='img' with an aria-label stating elapsed and total time, since visual width alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Transport buttons have descriptive aria-labels (Previous track, Play/Pause, Next track) rather than relying on icon shape alone.
The play/pause button's aria-label and icon both update together based on playback state.

variants.title: Now playing bar
variants.description: A docked player bar mid-track (1:23 of 3:47) with a computed scrubber fill, on a light surface.
accessibility: Scrubber width is elapsed/duration computed live, not a hand-typed percentage.

variants.title: Now playing bar (Dark)
variants.description: The same docked player bar, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Controls and text meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
